{{Quote|What program are you running, exactly, clone?''"<br />"''Routing analysis, to detect via which terminal the virus entered the network, and then purge it from the system, overweight female human.|Ellik and Jaing Skirata|<ref name="o66" />}}
'''Ellik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]].<ref name="o66" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she posed as a [[Central Republic Audit Office]] agent when she accompanied [[Republic Treasury/Legends|Republic Treasury]] agent [[Besany Wennen]], and two [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null Arcs]]: [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]] and [[Jaing Skirata|Jaing]], in inspecting the [[Republic Treasury Audit Division]] computers for a virus. Since the virus was Jaing's creation, he managed to fool Ellik into thinking it was a case of industrial espionage.<ref name="o66" />
